Ben / Alice — a few operational clarifications for the cutover runbook:

- Cutover phases (planned):
  1) Pre-cutover validation (30m): smoke tests, KV cache warm, traffic mirroring validation
  2) Traffic switch (5m): route 10% -> 50% -> 100% with health gates at each step
  3) Post-cutover validation (30m): throughput and latency checks, golden prompt health checks

- Immediate rollback steps (if a gate fails):
  - Repoint traffic to previous stable variant (automated rollback route)
  - Invalidate new KV caches and flush persistent ephemeral storage
  - Open incident channel and notify CS/Eng on-call

- Quick checklist for this week's dry-run:
  - Confirm automated rollback route exists (owner: neha_kapoor)
  - Load test with evens/odd keys to validate KV cache warm-up (owner: marissa_cole)
  - Smoke-test golden prompts in production-ghost environment (owner: karthik_iyer)

Attachment: cutover-runbook-v1.md

Neha Kapoor
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
